Widget family: BUTTON

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold):
1. A single rectangular control is visible with a clear outer edge (border or hard fill edge).
2. The control is larger than a small icon and reads as a pressable button, not a bare text label.
3. When the scene claims HOVER: the fill is noticeably lighter/brighter than the default button fill (not identical).
4. When the scene claims ACTIVE/PRESSED: the fill is noticeably darker than default (not identical).
5. When the scene claims DISABLED: the control is visibly dimmed (lower contrast fill and/or muted label ink) compared to a normal enabled button — not full-strength accent blue/white.
6. Label text (if present) sits inside the button bounds and is not clipped.

FAIL if: no control, text-only without a button chrome, wrong interaction state colors, clipped label, or disabled looks fully enabled.
